MOJO AI Summits
Virtual Calendar Schedule Format
2026-2027 virtual series

Executive AI conversations before the summit season.

MOJO AI Summits is building twelve focused virtual events for leaders responsible for AI adoption, data readiness, agents, integration, security, workforce adoption, platform decisions, investment, operations, and measurable business progress.

Cadence
Twelve Friday sessions from September 2026 through January 2027, each from 1:00 PM to 2:30 PM Central.
Audience
Executive and director-and-above leaders accountable for AI outcomes.
Purpose
Build trust, surface real operating questions, and prepare the 2027 summit pipeline.
Confirmed dates

Twelve virtual rooms, one executive AI arc.

The working topics are scaffolded so the team can refine speakers, partners, invite segments, and run-of-show details without changing the date and time architecture.

Operating format

Built as a working room, not a passive webinar.

Each event should give leaders a reason to attend live: practical framing, facilitated exchange, and a clear next relationship step.

01

Executive Briefing

A concise opening presentation frames the business decision, not just the technology trend.

02

Facilitated Exchange

Moderated prompts help leaders compare constraints, tradeoffs, and what is working in the field.

03

Relationship Follow-Up

Invite-qualified attendees can be routed into sponsor conversations, Member nominations, and city summit planning.

Invitation only

Curated rooms for the right AI leaders.

The fall series stays invitation-only, with access handled through direct outreach from the MOJO AI Summits team.
